I attacked it from the other direction this time: searching the indexed Multimedia Games domain for game/title/platform records and Xbox references. Multimedia's own FAQ confirms that a game has to be *featured on Multimedia Games* for the Chaturbate permission to apply. citeturn0search0

So we need to get the catalog **programmatically**, not manually.

Open urlMultimedia Gameshttps://games.multimediallc.com/ in Chrome. If the game list appears there, **send me the URL of the page after you reach the list**, even if it looks identical to that URL. I can investigate the site's requests/API endpoints from there and try to extract the entire catalog in one shot.

If that works, I'll then cross-reference the resulting titles against Xbox and give you exactly what you originally asked for: **the Chaturbate-authorized games that you can play on Xbox**, without you photographing 900 pages like some cursed 2003 document scanner.

parts:
I checked the live Multimedia Games system rather than relying on an old third-party list. There’s a snag: its public pages confirm that **only games featured on Multimedia Games have publisher/developer permission for Chaturbate**, but the actual featured-game catalog is not being exposed to web indexing/search in a way that lets me reliably enumerate it. citeturn0search0turn1search0

So I don't want to do what my previous answer implied I could do and hand you a bogus cross-reference. Searches for Xbox titles are producing ordinary Xbox games, not evidence that those games are actually authorized by Multimedia Games. For example, *Forza Motorsport*, *Lies of P*, *Dead Island 2*, etc. turn up as Xbox titles, but **I found no Multimedia Games authorization for them**, so I'm not going to label them safe. citeturn1search15turn1search17

The authoritative rule is unusually clear: Multimedia Games says it exists specifically so developers and publishers can grant Chaturbate broadcasters permission to stream their games. If a game **isn't featured**, their own FAQ says to contact the developer/publisher and ask them to add it. citeturn1search0

urlOpen the official Multimedia Games sitehttps://games.multimediallc.com/

Here's the fastest way around the catalog-access problem: **open that page on your phone and send me a screenshot of the games it shows**. If there are multiple pages, screenshots of the list are enough. I can visually identify the titles and cross-reference every one against Xbox One / Series X|S, then give you a clean **YES Xbox / NO Xbox** list. That gets us an actual answer instead of guessing which games Chaturbate currently licenses.

parts:
I did the cross-reference against the actual Chaturbate game list captured in your `.mht`, then checked the Xbox versions against Microsoft's current listings.

From the Chaturbate-authorized titles actually embedded in your downloaded page, these are playable on Xbox:

| Chaturbate-authorized game | Xbox One | Series X\|S |
|---|:---:|:---:|
| **VALORANT** | ❌ | ✅ |
| **Return to Monkey Island** | ❌ | ✅ |
| **Cult of the Lamb** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Enter the Gungeon** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **NOT A HERO: Super Snazzy Edition** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Exit the Gungeon** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Shadow Warrior** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Shadow Warrior 2** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Stardew Valley** | ✅ | ✅* |

Microsoft explicitly lists VALORANT for Series X|S. citeturn518339search0 Return to Monkey Island is also Series X|S. citeturn368545search2 Cult of the Lamb supports Xbox One and Series X|S. citeturn941994search4 Enter and Exit the Gungeon support both generations. citeturn368545search4turn368545search6

The Chaturbate **Not a Hero** entry corresponds to Roll7/Team17's *NOT A HERO*, not the identically named Resident Evil 7 DLC. Microsoft's store has the correct *Super Snazzy Edition*. citeturn368545search11 Shadow Warrior and Shadow Warrior 2 are both supported on Xbox One and Series consoles. citeturn941994search0turn941994search3 Stardew Valley has an Xbox One release and plays on current Xbox hardware through compatibility. citeturn318956search0

So, if you have a **Series X or Series S**, your confirmed Chaturbate-safe Xbox choices from the captured list are:

**VALORANT, Return to Monkey Island, Cult of the Lamb, Enter the Gungeon, NOT A HERO, Exit the Gungeon, Shadow Warrior, Shadow Warrior 2, and Stardew Valley.**

And there's a useful pattern hiding in there: **Devolver Digital is all over this list**. Return to Monkey Island, Cult of the Lamb, both Gungeon games, and both Shadow Warrior games are Devolver titles. That suggests Devolver has broadly participated in Multimedia/Chaturbate authorization, which makes their Xbox catalog particularly worth checking.

One correction to what I told you earlier: your `.mht` does **not** secretly contain the other 15 pages. It contains page 1's 20 game records plus links to pages 2–16. So these nine are **confirmed, not necessarily the entire Xbox-compatible Chaturbate catalog**. I'm not going to pretend the other 300-ish records are in the file when they aren't.

But for something you can install on the Xbox and stream **right now without guessing about Chaturbate authorization**, those nine are the solid set.

If by “streamable on Chaturbate” you mean **games you can play on your Xbox while showing the gameplay in your Chaturbate broadcast**, there’s an important catch: Chaturbate does **not** treat the Xbox catalog as automatically streamable.

Their current rule says copyrighted video games can appear in your broadcast only when you have permission from the rights holder. Chaturbate uses **Multimedia Games** as its permission system: publishers/developers explicitly authorize particular games for Chaturbate streaming. citeturn0search0turn2view0

So the useful question is actually:

**Which Chaturbate-approved games also have Xbox versions?**

I can cross-reference the **current Multimedia Games/Chaturbate approved catalog against the Xbox catalog** and give you the Xbox-playable ones. That will be much safer than relying on random lists online, especially because Chaturbate can suspend accounts for copyright violations. citeturn0search1

One thing I would *not* do is follow the advice floating around that says to select some approved game and then secretly play a different one. That directly conflicts with Chaturbate's published copyright rule. Their gaming platform specifically says that if a game isn't featured, the developer/publisher needs to grant permission and add it. citeturn2view0

urlChaturbate's authorized-game platform / Multimedia Gameshttps://games.multimediallc.com/

If you want, I can dig through that catalog now and produce **just the games you can actually get on Xbox Series X|S / Xbox One**, including Game Pass availability where applicable.
